a: Healthy businesses often aim for LTV significantly above CAC.
Gross margin is revenue minus cost of goods, over revenue.
Burn rate is how fast a company spends cash.
Conversion rate is conversions divided by visitors or leads.
ARPU is average revenue per user.
Net revenue retention tracks expansion minus churn.
SaaS tracks MRR/ARR, churn, CAC, LTV, and NRR.
Test pricing carefully; it strongly affects conversion and revenue.
Advantage can come from cost, brand, network effects, or unique tech.
